hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Unlike Part I, characters can appear multiple times with varying frequencies.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Sort character frequencies in descending order to assign the most frequent letters to the keys requiring 1 press.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For the character at rank i in descending order, the required presses are (i // 8 + 1) * count.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of input string word
complexity.notes: Frequency counting followed by sorting 26 character counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy without frequency sorting assigns high-frequency letters to deeper presses.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary frequency array of size 26.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort frequencies descending to prioritize cheapest keypresses for most frequent letters.
